Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if the BTC-USD spot price on Coinbase trades strictly above $100,000 USD at any point strictly after 2026-09-29T22:09:04.625Z and at or before 2026-12-25T05:00:00.000Z.
- "No": Wins if the BTC-USD spot price on Coinbase does not trade strictly above $100,000 USD at any point within the observation window.

Clarifications:
- The observation window opens strictly after 2026-09-29T22:09:04.625Z and closes at 2026-12-25T05:00:00.000Z. A single trade or last-traded price exceeding $100,000 USD at any moment within this window satisfies the "Yes" condition; the price must remain at or below $100,000 USD throughout the entire window for "No" to win.
